## Layer `Pack`

This directory holds the `Pack` layer. Its architecture rules:

- `packs/depends-on-core-only` — The Pack layer must reference only the Core layer or the Pack layer (external packages are not constrained by this rule). The rule pack ships as its own package for spec projects to reference, and the whole of what it needs is the Arch it composes onto. A reference to the extraction host or the CLI would pull MSBuild and the rest of the tool into the closure of every spec project that takes the pack — and nothing in the project graph stops it, because the pack is a leaf and no reference out of it would be circular.
- Expand any rule above with `loadbearing explain <rule-id>`.
